change_summary: Material Point Clear sensing recovery: all six expected owner cameras were capture-healthy with matching status, burst and vision at the 00:06:01 CDT identity, restoring Point Clear from 1/3 to 3/3 cameras. This is the first healthy identity after the 23:07 two-camera failure; one more consecutive healthy identity is required before closing J01. All three Point Clear views and one Montrose view have low nighttime detectability and remain UNKNOWN; two moderate-detectability Montrose views showed no Jubilee signal in visible scope. NOAA NGOFS2 guidance is unchanged: +59 m at 1 hour, +100 m at 3 hours, near neutral (-3 m) at 6 hours and +156 m at 12 hours, after seaward antecedent nowcast transport; it is MODEL guidance only. Both Hazcams viewers initially stalled. After Seek to live on Fairhope and one page reload, Grand Hotel and Fairhope advanced across isolated 25.162- and 25.161-second samples at 00:14 CDT with rolling endpoints and visible scene progression. No collecting, clustered searching, handheld lights or feeding birds were observed; darkness leaves biology UNKNOWN and neither Fairhope beach is visible. No credible September 9 first-person Jubilee report was found.
